description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}, causing you to draw three cards due to Eligeth and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
The Locust God triggers three times, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the three Insects, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.
